name: Ring Modulator (code)
author: Motion Audio
description: Multiplies the sound by a sine wave for bell-like, metallic tones. A code example with its own oscillator.
code:
// Ring modulator: a sine oscillator multiplied with the input.
@sample
ph += freq / srate
ph -= floor(ph)
m = sin(2 * pi * ph)
outL = mix(inL, inL * m, amount)
outR = mix(inR, inR * m, amount)
